card.fact_statement: The Xiaomi YU7 received 196,000 pre-order deposits within two minutes of its launch presentation ending.
card.source_span: Within two minutes of the 26 June 2025 launch presentation ending at 10:00 p.m., the YU7 received 196,000 pre-order deposits
